home.title: Grihum Earthy Studio | Architecture & Interior Design Studio
home.desc: Grihum Earthy Studio designs homes, villas, resorts and interiors rooted in earth, light and craft. Sustainable architecture with a warm, timeless character.
home.h: We design homes that feel like the earth beneath them.
home.p: Grihum Earthy Studio creates warm, sustainable architecture, from villas and resorts to interiors, shaped by natural materials, local craft and honest light.

blocks.h: Architecture that belongs to its land
ps: Our name comes from Grih, the Sanskrit word for home. Every project begins by listening to the site: its soil, sun path, wind and climate. We then shape buildings that sit gently in the landscape and stay comfortable naturally.

We favour earth, stone, lime, timber and terracotta because they age beautifully, breathe, and carry the touch of the artisans who made them. The result is architecture that feels calm, grounded and unmistakably yours.

ps: We begin with your life, not a template. How you wake, cook, gather, work and rest shapes every room, door and window. This makes homes that feel personal, not copied.

Our team handles everything, from architecture and interiors to landscape and site supervision, so you deal with one studio and one clear vision. Budgets, timelines and materials are discussed openly from day one.
Our buildings are comfortable by design. Orientation, shade, thick walls and cross-ventilation reduce heat and energy bills, while natural finishes keep the air fresh and the spaces calm.

about.title: About Us | Grihum Earthy Studio Architects
about.desc: Learn about Grihum Earthy Studio: our story, philosophy, team approach and commitment to sustainable, earthy architecture and interiors.
about.h: A studio built on earth, craft and care.
about.p: We are a design practice that believes the best buildings are quiet, honest and deeply connected to place.

ps: Grihum Earthy Studio was founded with a simple idea: modern living does not have to mean losing touch with the earth. We saw too many buildings that ignored climate, culture and craft, and set out to design differently.

Today our studio brings together architects, interior designers and craftspeople who share one belief: a home should be a refuge. Warm in winter, cool in summer, and beautiful at every hour of the day.

We design with the five elements in mind: earth, water, air, light and space. Each building responds to its site, using courtyards, shaded edges and natural ventilation to reduce energy use while increasing comfort.
Our terracotta and sun-yellow identity reflects this: the colour of fired clay and the warmth of golden hour, the two moods we try to capture in every space.

items: We study your lifestyle, budget, land and aspirations before drawing a single line.
Concepts, 3D visuals and material palettes help you see and feel the space early.
Precise drawings and craft-led specifications make construction smooth.
On-site supervision ensures the finished building matches the vision.

ps: India has centuries of wisdom in building with climate: courtyards, stepped shade, jaalis, thick walls and local craft. We study these ideas and reinterpret them with modern planning, engineering and comfort.
The result is architecture that feels familiar yet fresh, respectful of heritage but made for today’s families, travellers and workplaces.
